title: EasyOPD: An Easy-to-use On-Policy Distillation Framework for Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2607.11012v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Conventional language-model distillation often relies on fixed teacher-generated data, which may not cover the states encountered by an evolving student policy. On-policy distillation (OPD) instead collects teacher or evaluator supervision on student-generated rollouts. However, existing OPD methods differ substantially in supervision form, tokenizer compatibility, teacher access, and supervision granularity, leading to fragmented implementations that are difficult to reproduce and extend. We present \textsc{EasyOPD}, an on-policy distillation framework built on verl, a distributed reinforcement-learning framework for large language models. \textsc{EasyOPD} separates user-side configuration, method-specific supervision logic, and verl-based execution. translated_title: EasyOPD：一个易于使用的大语言模型在线策略蒸馏框架
translated_abstract: 传统的大语言模型蒸馏通常依赖于固定的教师生成数据，这可能无法覆盖不断演进的学生策略所遇到的状态。在线策略蒸馏（OPD）则改为在学生生成的轨迹上收集教师或评估器的监督信号。然而，现有的OPD方法在监督形式、分词器兼容性、教师模型访问方式以及监督粒度方面存在显著差异，导致实现碎片化，难以复现和扩展。我们提出了EasyOPD，一个基于verl（面向大语言模型的分布式强化学习框架）构建的在线策略蒸馏框架。EasyOPD将用户侧配置、方法特定的监督逻辑和基于verl的执行三者相互分离。其方法模块通过扩展边界与共享后端连接，这些扩展边界涵盖损失构建、轨迹元数据、奖励处理、分词器对齐以及教师侧计算等方面。
tldr: 本文提出EasyOPD，一个基于verl构建的易用在线策略蒸馏框架，通过解耦用户配置、方法监督逻辑与底层执行，统一了现有OPD方法碎片化的实现方式，使框架更易于复现和扩展。
en_tdlr: EasyOPD is an easy-to-use on-policy distillation framework built on verl that decouples user-side configuration, method-specific supervision logic, and execution, unifying fragmented OPD implementations to improve reproducibility and extensibility.
